WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', enrolled_at) AS month, course_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM enrollments
  GROUP BY month, course_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT month, course_id, cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY cnt DESC, course_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT month, course_id, cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1 AND cnt >= 5
ORDER BY month;

SELECT c.id, c.title, COUNT(l.id) AS lesson_count, SUM(l.duration_min) / 60.0 AS total_hours
FROM courses c
JOIN chapters ch ON ch.course_id = c.id
JOIN lessons l ON l.chapter_id = ch.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.title
HAVING COUNT(l.id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_hours DESC
